db: server/data/recruitmatch.sqlite (shared dev) — NO MUTATION this phase

part_G_coach_seasons.proof: coach_seasons is populated from an external NCAA-only coach-tenure CSV (importCoachTenure.js, no division filter in code). NAIA was never part of that acquisition. The corroboration gate depends on data NAIA was structurally never given.

part_H_email.caveat: 798/801 NAIA 'verified' emails are bulk legacy (graduating_seniors) with NO email_seen observation evidence; spot-validation found 1/4 verified-labeled addresses did not match the officially published address (Bryan College). The 'verified' label for NAIA is systematically under-evidenced.

part_I_currentness.note: currentness is NOT a NAIA blocker (UNKNOWN passes the gate); no PROVEN_STALE.

part_J_tiers.note: covered 2 + uncovered 372 + NO_COACH_DATA-not-in-ledger 4 = ... coverage classes reconcile to 384 active (2 covered + 378 ineligible-only + 4 no-coach-data); the 372 tiered are the ineligible-only with >=1 coach row minus the 6 that had no school-attached ledger rows.

sim2_domain_fixes_only_gate_kept.lesson: domain verification WITHOUT a corroboration path barely helps NAIA

sim3_alt_path_strict_email_seen_current.lesson: an alt-path requiring email_seen+CURRENT unlocks almost nothing because NAIA rows lack observation/currentness evidence (email_seen 6/1061)

sim4_inferred_prohibited.lesson: the 236-programme unlock relies entirely on verified-labeled emails, not inferred
